title: Conjecture 2.5 — Vassiliev invariants distinguish oriented knots.
exact_target: Can some finite-type invariant distinguish every pair of distinct oriented knot types, allowing its degree to depend on the pair?

sources.citation: ULAM. AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10400027 (AMR-103-0027). CC BY 4.0.

T. Ohtsuki (editor), \emph{Problems on invariants of knots and 3-manifolds}, Geometry \& Topology Monographs 4 (2002), pp. 377--572 (published 2004), item 2.5 and its surrounding definitions and remarks.
